//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the PROFILE PANEL — the `.pa-profile-panel` block (keen `PureAdmin.Components.Profile.profile_panel/1`, svelte `profile/ProfilePanel.svelte`). SCOPE = the panel CONTAINER + its INLINE HEADER. The component is a slide-in side sheet: both wrappers ALWAYS emit the shell (overlay + content), the full header (avatar + info name/email + close button), and an (initially empty) body; optional tabs / nav / actions / footer regions are driven by slots. The HEADER is authored inline from the required `name` + `email` props (and an optional `role` badge), so it is IN SCOPE and fully blessed in the goldens. The item-level children of the nav / favorites / tabs regions (pa-profile-panel__nav-item / __nav-icon / __favorite-* / __tab-text) come from SEPARATE sub-components (svelte ProfilePanelNavItem / ProfilePanelFavorites / ProfilePanelFavoriteItem, keen profile_nav_item/1) fed through those slots — the generic dumper passes slot content as plain escaped TEXT, so those classes cannot materialize here and there is no fragment dumper wiring for them. They are DEFERRED as acknowledged prose (like accent-grid / list item sub-components). This fixture proves the shell + header + the region-WRAPPER classes (__nav / __actions / __tabs / __footer) the panel itself emits when a slot is present. See card.json (header shape), accent-grid.json / list.json (container-only + deferred item sub-components), modal.json (required id/name/email attrs supplied via the map), stat.json (JS state class). Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away. EXACT block class = pa-profile-panel (NOT pa-profile).

propsVocabulary.id: root id="..." — the toggle/close JS target the core snippet carries (toggleProfilePanel/closeProfilePanel(id)). keen's profile_panel/1 has `id` with a default ("profile-panel") and ALWAYS renders id={@id}. svelte's ProfilePanel originally had NO id prop; an optional `id` prop (rendered `{id}` on the root, omitted when unset) was added in this slice so the wrapper can emit the snippet's root id — mirrors the modal `id` fix. Both maps declare it; every golden includes it (modal precedent).
propsVocabulary.name: REQUIRED user display name → <h3 class="pa-profile-panel__name" title="{name}">. keen's profile_panel/1 REQUIRES this attr (KeyErrors without it); supplied through the map as a string feature so it flows into the assigns.
propsVocabulary.email:
REQUIRED user email →

. Also keen-required; supplied via the map as a string feature.
propsVocabulary.role: optional role badge text → {role} inside __info. Both wrappers gate the badge on role being present; unset = no badge. The badge is the SHARED pa-badge component (migrated from a bespoke __role element in 2.9.0), not a pa-profile-panel element — so it carries no __ class and is rendered as plain content, structural only.
propsVocabulary.noAvatar: boolean — hides the avatar for corporate apps without photos; adds pa-profile-panel__header--no-avatar to the header. The __avatar/__avatar-icon markup stays in place (the modifier hides it via CSS). svelte prop hasAvatar (negated), keen has_avatar (negated).
propsVocabulary.iconOnlyTabs: boolean — tabs show only icons; adds pa-profile-panel__tabs--icon-only to the tabs wrapper (needs the tabs slot). svelte hasIconOnlyTabs, keen has_icon_only_tabs.
propsVocabulary.tabs: optional tab strip between header and body (pa-profile-panel__tabs wrapper). Slot content is the shared .pa-tabs component in real use; here a plain text token.

propsVocabulary.actions: in-body action buttons region (pa-profile-panel__actions). Deprecated in favour of footer, but both wrappers still emit it from the slot.
propsVocabulary.footer: fixed footer region pinned to the bottom (pa-profile-panel__footer) — sibling of __body inside __content.

goldenConventions: Both wrappers ALWAYS emit the shell (root .pa-profile-panel > .pa-profile-panel__overlay + .pa-profile-panel__content), the header (.pa-profile-panel__header > .pa-profile-panel__avatar > .pa-profile-panel__avatar-icon, .pa-profile-panel__info > __name + __email [+ optional pa-badge], and the __close button), and the .pa-profile-panel__body (initially empty) — so every golden encodes the full shell+header even when no body region is supplied. The DEFAULT avatar glyph is the masked `.pa-icon pa-icon--user` primitive wrapped in __avatar-icon (the blessed snippet shape; svelte previously emitted a 👤 emoji — fixed in this slice). The __name/__email carry title="{value}" tooltip attrs (both wrappers). The __close button carries aria-label="Close Profile" (both wrappers resolve their close-label i18n/literal to the same Title-Case string — svelte's en `closeProfile`; keen hard-codes it; keen was "Close profile" and is corrected to match in this slice) and an inner <span class="pa-icon pa-icon--x" aria-hidden="true">. The root --open class is JS-only state (cssStateClasses) and never appears in an SSR golden: svelte would emit it from show=true but every scenario leaves show falsy; keen adds it only via a runtime JS command. Region WRAPPERS (__nav / __actions / __tabs / __footer) appear only when their slot is supplied; their item CHILDREN are the deferred sub-components, so a region golden carries a plain text token where the real items would be.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (grep pa-profile-panel). The only BLOCK modifier is pa-profile-panel--open (JS state → cssStateClasses; axis-1 block-modifier reverse-check is satisfied by it). Element modifiers (__header--no-avatar, __tabs--icon-only) are verified forward. `produces: null` = structural/native (emits markup but no pa-profile-panel modifier class).

id.note: structural — root id="..." (toggle/close JS target). keen always renders it (default "profile-panel"); svelte gained an optional `id` prop in this slice (rendered on the root, omitted when unset) — modal precedent. Both goldens include it.

name.note: structural — <h3 class="pa-profile-panel__name" title="{name}">; REQUIRED by keen. The __name element is exercised by every header golden.

email.note:
structural —

; REQUIRED by keen. The __email element is exercised by every header golden.

role.note: structural — optional {role} (shared badge component, no pa-profile-panel__ class); gated on presence.

iconOnlyTabs.note: needs the tabs slot present to have a wrapper to modify.

tabs.note: tab-strip wrapper between header and body; item children (pa-tabs / __tab-text) are deferred.

nav.note: nav region wrapper; the <li> items (__nav-item/__nav-icon) are the deferred sub-component.

cssStateClasses.//: Block modifier toggled by runtime JS, never hand-authored at SSR — so no feature produces it and it stays out of every golden. Satisfies the axis-1 block-modifier reverse-check.
cssStateClasses.pa-profile-panel--open: Open/visible state (opacity/visibility/pointer-events + content slide-in). Toggled by toggleProfilePanel/closeProfilePanel JS (svelte: `show` prop → class; keen: JS.toggle_class/remove_class). svelte would emit it only when show=true, keen only at runtime after a JS command, so no shared SSR golden can assert it — every scenario leaves it off.

deferred.//: Item-level element classes of the pa-profile-panel block — NOT the panel's own markup. They are emitted by SEPARATE sub-components fed through the nav / favorites / tabs slots (svelte ProfilePanelNavItem / ProfilePanelFavorites / ProfilePanelFavoriteItem, keen profile_nav_item/1 + author-supplied favorites/tabs markup), which the generic dumper passes as plain escaped TEXT — so they cannot materialize here, and there is no fragment fixture/dumper wiring to fixture-ref (a ref would DEFER?-fail). Acknowledged as prose. The region WRAPPERS these live inside (__nav / __actions / __tabs / __footer) ARE in scope and exercised by goldens.
deferred.pa-profile-panel__nav-item: nav-item sub-component (svelte ProfilePanelNavItem / keen profile_nav_item/1) — the <li><a> menu row; slot-fed, no fragment fixture/dumper wiring.
deferred.pa-profile-panel__nav-icon: nav-item sub-component — the fixed-width icon slot inside a nav row.
deferred.pa-profile-panel__favorites: favorites sub-component (svelte ProfilePanelFavorites) — the <ul> wrapper inside a tab panel; slot-fed, out of container scope.
deferred.pa-profile-panel__favorite-item: favorite-item sub-component (svelte ProfilePanelFavoriteItem) — the clickable row <div> (data-href + JS navigate).
deferred.pa-profile-panel__favorite-icon: favorite-item sub-component — the fixed-width icon slot.
deferred.pa-profile-panel__favorite-label: favorite-item sub-component — the flex:1 label text.
deferred.pa-profile-panel__favorite-remove: favorite-item sub-component — the × remove button (opacity:0 until row hover; runtime JS removes the <li>).
deferred.pa-profile-panel__favorites-add: favorites sub-component — the bottom '+ Add Current Page' wrapper.
deferred.pa-profile-panel__tab-text: tab-strip content — the text label inside a .pa-tabs__item, hidden by __tabs--icon-only; part of the author-supplied/shared .pa-tabs markup in the tabs slot, not the panel's own wrapper.
